risk.risk: Consent coverage or timezone/aggregation may distort metrics
risk.impact: Browser counts may be misrepresented as people and historical trends corrupted; D9/16 have high reversal cost
risk.mitigation: Use consented anonymous browsers only. Preserve UTC events, recompute complete retained ranges only, display data watermark and timezone revision, and test DST and late arrivals in isolation.
risk.trigger: An event is stored without consent, missing samples become zero, or incomplete raw history replaces a full aggregate
